replacement_requirements: Supplier-provided product photograph with documented commercial display rights.
Display only beside the exact supplier name and exact pictured product. Never associate with a fictional or generic TrueTone product.
Record supplier, product id/name, source, permission/license, hash and review date before use.
Self-host locally. No image hotlinks, customer photos, tracking embeds or Shopify integration are introduced by this page.
Use object-fit: contain in square or 4:5 neutral frames. Preserve source packaging and marks; do not relabel or crop a different brand into a generic asset.
cancelled_generation: Gemini attempt by orchestrator failed with quota errors and produced no images. Founder cancelled AI generation; no active prompts remain.
editorial_use: Object photos illustrate cosmetic objects/preferences only, never skin results, scan outputs, listed products, supplier identity or endorsements. Portraits not copied or used.
